title: tribulocarpus somalensis
intro: Tribulocarpus somalensis, commonly known as Somali tribulus, is a plant species in the family Zygophyllaceae. It is a shrub-like succulent that has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Tribulocarpus somalensis include its potential to improve cardiovascular health, reduce stress and anxiety, and boost the immune system. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, that have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and adaptogenic properties.
